summary: Frontend testing of S.T.E.W.A.R.D. Workspace Trash Pipeline completed successfully. All 11 requested features tested and verified working correctly. The unified Trash Pipeline properly captures deleted items from all modules (Notes, Tasks, People, Goals) and window operations (X button close, CANVAS sidebar removal).

issues: Minor: Goals are categorized as 'Ostatní' (Other) type in trash instead of having their own dedicated type. Consider adding TRASH_TYPES.GOAL for better categorization.

critical_code_review_comments: TrashContext.js: Well-structured with proper addToTrash, addWindowToTrash, addNoteToTrash, addTaskToTrash, addPersonToTrash functions
TrashContext.js: localStorage persistence works correctly via STORAGE_KEYS.TRASH_ITEMS
DraggableModule.jsx (line 466-476): X button correctly calls addWindowToTrash before removeModule
RightSidebar.jsx (line 65-69): handleRemoveFromCanvas correctly calls addWindowToTrash before removeFromCanvas
NotesModule.jsx (line 27-31): handleDeleteNote correctly calls addNoteToTrash before deleteNote
TasksModule.jsx (line 24-28): handleDeleteTask correctly calls addTaskToTrash before deleteTask
PeopleModule.jsx (line 190-198): deletePerson correctly calls addPersonToTrash before removing from state
GoalsModule.jsx (line 123-137): deleteGoal correctly calls addToTrash with TRASH_TYPES.OTHER
TrashModule.jsx: Proper implementation of restore (handleRestore), permanent delete (handleDelete), and empty trash (handleEmptyTrash) with confirmation
TrashModule.jsx: Filter functionality works correctly with TYPE_CONFIG mapping
seed_data_creation: Test items created and deleted during testing: NOTE_FOR_TRASH, TASK_FOR_TRASH, RESTORE_TEST_NOTE, EMPTY_TEST_1
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trash Pipeline fully tested. All delete/close actions properly send items to central Trash. Trash module supports filtering by type (Vše, Okna, Poznámky, Projekty, Lidi, Úkoly), restore functionality, permanent delete (X button), and empty trash with confirmation. localStorage key: steward_trash_items
